subject: Preventing memory problems with savewav and large audio files

messages.author: 296a3eb14b082592
messages.subject: Preventing memory problems with savewav and large audio files
parts:
Hello,

I am using tuneR and seewave to read in .MP3 files, extract the left channel, and save it, roughly like this:

library(tuneR); library(seewave)
 
z <- mono(readMP3("MP3_file.MP3"), "left")                   # read MP3 and take only left channel 

savewav(z, filename = paste0("left", "MP3_file.MP3"))     # save the left channel into a new final
rm(z)                                                                          # remove the object, move to next file

This works great when my input .MP3 (44.1 kHz, stereo, 16-bit) files are less than about 45 MB.  But on my 8 GB 64-bit Windows machine without any other programs open, going much beyond this causes either errors or warnings regarding memory limits (see below) during the the call to savewav.  Is there some better way to go about this task that would prevent errors and warnings?  I looked into some of the packages in the Cran Task View for high-performance computing, but it wasn't immediately apparent to me that any of them could help with audio files.  Will it be necessary to move out of R or to cut these files into smaller pieces and somehow join the smaller saved files together afterwards?  Any advice would be appreciated.

Here is an example error:

Error in validObject(.Object) : 
  invalid class “WaveMC” object: Error : cannot allocate vector of size 1.3 Gb
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In structure(list(message = as.character(message), call = call),  :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In structure(list(message = as.character(message), call = call),  :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)
3: In structure(list(message = as.character(message), call = call),  :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)
4: In structure(list(message = as.character(message), call = call),  :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)

and here is an example warning from trying this process on a 52 MB file

Warning messages:
1: In writeWave(wave, filename = filename) :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In writeWave(wave, filename = filename) :
  Reached total allocation of 8081Mb: see help(memory.size)

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Preventing memory problems with savewav and large audio files
parts:
Hello,
I would suggest to use SoX for this kind of manipulations. You can call SoX from seewave with the function sox().
See this discussion: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/seewave/vk1Rd3D7zjg/zrjMyMomBnAJ
Best
Jerome
